text: Skills are Agent SDK skill files shipped read-only inside the claude_agent node (loaded on demand; the agent cannot edit them); runner options enable skills while the agent's file tools stay away from the skill directory.

POI categories (targets, slow zones, keep-out zones, problem spots, details) map onto the existing POI kinds/zones/fields with no new schema field: documented mapping, tools and validation for consistent recording; creating a keep-out is free, removing one still needs user consent.
Slow (risky) zones add Nav2 path cost (the planner routes around them when possible) and cap speed inside; keep-out zones stay hard; Nav2 Jazzy filter behaviour verified and the mechanism chosen.
Survey skill: base rotation now, automatically using head rotation, zoom and the 3D map when those tools exist; records POIs of all categories with photos and notes.

Sightseeing skill plus an exploration-status tool (reachable frontiers, surveyed areas): done when no reachable frontier is left and every frontier area has been surveyed; a summary for the user; stops at configurable time and battery limits.

Planning skill and a start_workflow tool seeding the job's task plan from templates for discovery, drive-to-target and pick-up/put-down; the agent may add/reorder steps; the job-end check flags skipped mandatory steps; jobs start from free text only.

Retrospective skill: written after every job (short for trivial jobs) to a robot-side store, shown in a web UI tab and available through an API and a script; recent retrospectives are fed to future agents.
Survey POIs are cleared on New session (no persistence beyond the session), consistent with the existing agent POI reset; keep-out zones always survive it.

Tests (claude_agent, mcp_server, poi_store, costmap_zones, web_ui), evals extended beyond pick-and-place where cheap, READMEs; deployed while respecting that deploying claude_agent/mcp_server kills a running agent session.
Skills are Agent SDK skill files shipped read-only in the node and loaded on demand.

POI categories (targets, slow zones, keep-out zones, problem spots such as windows, mirrors, tight places and obstacles above the lidar plane, details) are mapped onto the existing POI kinds/zones/fields - no new schema field; creating a keep-out is free, removing one still needs consent.
Slow zones add Nav2 path cost AND cap speed; keep-outs stay hard.
Retrospectives after every job (short for trivial ones) in a robot-side store, shown in a web UI tab and an API/script, recent ones fed to future agents.
Jobs start from free text only (no web UI workflow buttons).
Workflows seed the plan via a template; the agent may add/reorder; the job-end check flags skipped mandatory steps.
Survey/sightseeing built on base rotation now, using head/zoom/3D tools automatically when they exist.
Map complete = no reachable frontiers and every frontier area surveyed, summary to the user, configurable time/battery limits.
Survey POIs are cleared on New session, except keep-out zones, which always survive (amended by U10).
The web UI POI list filters by category, marks POIs individually or all visible, and deletes the marked ones in one confirmed action through the shared POI delete operation.

Keep-out zones survive New session (the reset clears the other survey POIs, never keep-outs); the web UI POI list can be filtered by category, POIs marked individually, mark all visible marks every POI passing the filter, delete marked deletes them in one action with a confirmation naming the count and listing categories, and keep-outs in the batch need an explicit extra confirmation; a poi_store batch delete-by-ids and web_ui route are reused from the named-maps clear work, not duplicated.
